meta.title: Cache CloudInfo / CloudSettings by authority
meta.body_summary: Modify CloudSettings to cache CloudInfo by authority (scheme+host+port) instead of full URL, reducing redundant network requests for the same cluster accessed with different paths.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot cached CloudInfo by authority; AsafMah CHANGES_REQUESTED for formatting, test placement, and pytest conversion; after iterative fixes, PR merged.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 890 changed lines, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, concentrated in test files and a core caching modification. It fits a small-step performance optimization PR that successfully merged after addressing review feedback on formatting, test location, and test framework conventions.

core_change_summary.description: Modify _cloud_settings.py: _normalize_uri now extracts authority (scheme+netloc) instead of full URL; get_cloud_info_for_cluster uses authority as cache key; add test_cloud_settings.py with pytest tests for normalization and caching behavior.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Multiple test files were added and later removed or reverted as part of review cleanup; e2e test modifications were fully undone.
